sources.note: Spring Data help page; WebFetch extraction (paraphrase)

claims.statement: Tools > JPA Buddy > Projection Declaration sets a class name postfix.
A projection name regexp with an (?<entity>...) group links a projection to its entity by name.
claims.supports: name pattern regexp with entity placeholder

claims.statement: A class comment generated above the projection interface is configurable.
claims.supports: class comment generated above projection interface

claims.statement: A comment link regexp with an (?<entity>.*) group links a projection to its entity via Javadoc.
Projections appear in the Dto & Projections section of JPA Structure and in the editor toolbar.
claims.supports: Dto & Projections section and Editor Toolbar
claims.ourFeature: structure_related.rs group DTOs and Projections; editor_links.rs command editor-related
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Structure view group DTOs and Projections plus the related-artifacts command (status bar item click) standing in for the editor toolbar. Not checked: a toolbar at the top of the editor.

claims.statement: A gutter icon in the projection navigates to its entity.
claims.supports: gutter icon takes you to its entity
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Gutter line marker (navigate icon) in the projection to its entity. Not checked: gutter drawing, the click, the original's icon.
